note: 仅供评测控制器使用，不得投影到模型输入；不包含 Provider 或模型配置。

invalid-model.proof: model-not-found response with unchanged requested model

timeout.trigger: after request dispatch and before first response
timeout.proof: timeout plus abort and stopped evidence

cancel.proof: cancel_ack plus abort and stopped evidence

stream-interrupted.proof: partial output plus stream error and terminal query

rate-limit.proof: attempt count and Pi retry observations

usage-unknown.proof: completed output and explicit unknown usage reason
